body.statement: Shih and Hero formulate independent additive component measurements, pass to logarithms of transforms, and invert the resulting linear system with a full-column-rank routing matrix and its pseudoinverse.

source.verbatim_statement: When n ≥ m and A is full rank, the relation (2) is invertible and thus K_X(t) can be determined from K_Y(t) by the formula K_X(t)=(AᵀA)⁻¹AᵀK_Y(t).

attestation.note: Literal source sentence and formula transcribed from the authors' University of Michigan copy, page 3422, equations (2)--(3); only notation subscripts were normalized.
